plate: LoC 27004508 image 0016 (Russell Periodic Chart), source_scans/loc/full/p0016.jpg, 2712x3264 8-bit gray

metrics.M1_stroke_width: Erosion-depth distribution on ink pixels inside ROI: d(p) = number of successive 3x3 binary erosions survived. Report median and P90 of d; approx stroke width ~ 2d-1 px. Computed identically for every variant.
metrics.M2_min_xheight: Cap-height in px of smallest inner-ring label class, measured on crop L09_silver_cluster ('SILVER' radial text): count of ink rows across letter body on the binarized crop, reported per variant.
metrics.M3_broken_glyphs: Visual count of broken glyphs (letter fragmented into >1 piece) and falsely-touching glyph pairs (letters merged that are separate in raw) in the FIXED 20-label sample, per variant contact sheet. Lower broken = better; touching counts flag over-repair.
metrics.M4_speckle: Number of 8-connected ink components inside ROI with area <= 4 px (speckle count), and total component count.
metrics.M5_ink_fraction: Fraction of ROI pixels that are ink; sanity guard against over/under-binarization.

selection_note: Boxes chosen on the RAW scan from a contact sheet before any pipeline variant existed; mix of node labels (L01-L08), small inner-ring radial text (L09-L12,L19,L20), large outer arc text (L13-L15,L18), letterpress header/caption (L16,L17).
